questions.question: American driver Kyle Larson recently secured his first victory at the famous Talladega Superspeedway in which motorsport series?
questions.explanation: Driving for Hendrick Motorsports, Kyle Larson achieved his inaugural NASCAR Cup Series win at the Talladega circuit by taking the YellaWood 500.
questions.context: 2026 NASCAR Cup Series > 2026 YellaWood 500: In auto racing, American driver Kyle Larson of Hendrick Motorsports wins the YellaWood 500 at the Talladega Superspeedway in Alabama, winning his first NASCAR Cup Series race at the circuit.

questions.question: Which Brazilian political leader secured a fourth non-consecutive term following a closely fought presidential run-off election?
questions.explanation: Incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won the second round of voting with 52 percent of the vote, making history by coming from second place in the first round to win.
questions.context: 2026 Brazilian general election: Lula wins re-election 52 to 48 percent, defeating Bolsonaro for a fourth non-consecutive term and becoming the first Brazilian presidential candidate to have placed second in the first round but win the second round.

questions.story: Middle Eastern crisis > Houthi–Saudi conflict, Yemeni civil war > 2026 Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
questions.question: King Khalid International Airport was forced to temporarily suspend and then resume limited flights due to regional conflict in which country?
questions.explanation: The major airport in Riyadh Province re-opened on a limited basis following two weeks of disruption caused by incoming missile and drone attacks.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > Houthi–Saudi conflict, Yemeni civil war > 2026 Houthi attacks on Saudi airports: Saudi-led coalition air defences intercept a Houthi ballistic missile and two drones targeting Riyadh Province as King Khalid International Airport resumes limited operations after a two-week closure caused by earlier Houthi attacks.

questions.question: Health authorities in Nigeria have launched enhanced contact tracing efforts after detecting a case of which disease in the capital city?
questions.explanation: Nigerian officials confirmed a case of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in Abuja, prompting immediate tracking of dozens of potential contacts.
questions.context: 2026 Ebola epidemic: The Nigerian health ministry expands contact tracing after confirming an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case in Abuja, identifying at least 44 contacts while investigating additional people who may have been exposed and strengthening infection-control measures.

questions.question: Which French political figure has officially launched a campaign for the upcoming 2027 presidential election?
questions.explanation: National Rally figurehead Marine Le Pen has publicly confirmed her candidacy for the next French presidential contest.
questions.context: 2027 French presidential election: Marine Le Pen of the National Rally announces her presidential campaign.
